extractions.quote: Our patient is unusual as she presented with abnormal fixed postures in the strict hemi-distribution... Some patients with fixed dystonic postures of the limb(s) or hemi-body (and in the absence of structural brain lesion) may be misdiagnosed as psychogenic if SPS is not considered in the differential diagnosis
